title: The traffic head refitted on closed-loop data, in round 29's and round 33's net2 unchanged, validation links
description: Driving a net2 that takes its belief in copies from it, net1 v7's traffic head locks: on 4 of 21 validation links with a Cubic flow that started first it holds P(copies) near 1 for the whole minute (none beside the fixed rule), since the cooperative window shrinks with the flow's own share and the starved flow then looks like a copy (exp-traffic-head-cubic-first-305). Refitted on data from the policies that read it (exp-traffic-head-v7-agg-306), the head calls that Cubic flow copies in 15% of closed-loop steps instead of 20% and keeps 0.874 balanced accuracy beside the fixed rule. This puts the refitted head into the same net2s unchanged, as net1 alone is repaired: round 29's students with both beliefs from it (net2-v7hpn) and round 33's at iteration 59 reading it and taking their belief in copies from it (net2-r33hn), beside round 29's students with both beliefs from the old head (net2-v7hp), round 29's and round 33's with their own beliefs (net2-v7, net2-r33) and the fixed rule at u = 0.25 (rule-v7), all thresholds at 0.5, on the validation links at campaign seed 21 (the five families) and among 2 and 4 copies. Reading, stated before the results: the refit carries over if net2-v7hpn or net2-r33hn gains at least 0.05 over net2-v7 among copies and loses no more than 0.02 on the five-family mean, both over three seeds; how much of the loss with Cubic first it recovers against net2-v7hp is reported either way.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); H="$IN/h/traffic_head.pt"; echo "62043107ace9c7c3c913124f42d26023474ec6108cc59d959475da6bd57820be  $H" | sha256sum -c; G="$IN/n/traffic_head.pt"; echo "8ad397a52a7f09fc2b2a136f017d0a52b49a5f0bfcae9f10040d8a015891f2e8  $G" | sha256sum -c; mkdir -p "$OUT/p"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule-v7" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v7=$OUT/rule-v7/rule-u0.25.onnx"); for s in 1 2 3; do d="$OUT/runs/r29-s$s"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7hp-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --traffic "$H" --traffic-p; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7hpn-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --traffic "$G" --traffic-p; r="$IN/r/ppo-r33-s$s"; e="$OUT/runs/r33-s$s"; mkdir -p "$e"; cp "$r/net1.pt" "$r/traffic_head.pt" "$r/ppo_spec.json" "$e/"; cp "$r/iter059/actor.pt" "$e/actor.pt"; cmp "$e/traffic_head.pt" "$H"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-r33-s$s" "$e" --t 0.5; cp "$G" "$e/traffic_head.pt"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-r33hn-s$s" "$e" --t 0.5 --traffic "$G"; for a in v7 v7hp v7hpn r33 r33hn; do P+=(--policy "net2-$a-s$s=$OUT/p/net2-$a-s$s.onnx"); done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 32 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"; rm -rf "$OUT/runs"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
